verdict.rationale: Azure's own managed identities let applications obtain Microsoft Entra tokens without managing any credentials, which covers the service-side half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows OIDC or workload identity federation for external CI systems, or end-to-end documentation of a no-long-lived-key setup. Missing for 10: OIDC/workload identity federation for CI pipelines, explicit short-lived token lifetime evidence, end-to-end setup documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, nothing ships a long-lived key — OIDC/workload identity federation issues short-lived credentials to CI and services, documented end to end

citations.quote: Applications can use managed identities to obtain Microsoft Entra tokens without having to manage any credentials.
